data.text:
### scale proof
Trusted by 6,500+ businesses globally per chargebee.com.
### problem mechanism
Pricing lists 100M usage events/mo Flow, up to 500M Enterprise with real-time aggregation — high-volume metering complexity uncertain if painful.
### cost evidence
No problem cost stated on pages fetched — uncertain.
### counter-evidence
Status: All Systems Operational; only brief Sep 17 EU API degradation from AWS issue.
### wedge fit
Already offers analytics plus export to S3/Snowflake/BI, so wedge uncertain.
### verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no)
No.
### why
Scale proven but no evidenced costly problem from own domain to justify pay.
